content.intro: Learn advanced reporting and analytics through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.
content.why_it_matters: Advanced Reporting and Analytics matters because a Django project has to behave predictably across requests, database state, configuration, and deployments. Understanding this piece makes the surrounding application easier to test, maintain, and secure.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines advanced reporting and analytics as part of advanced ecosystem and specialized applications. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.

content_blocks.title: What to cover
